event.value: The gate opened onto a pageant; Prince Lunareth received the armed boor as a protocol problem and offered the envoy's rites, the wine, and the exit, in that order. Courtly alarm, protocol as armor.

First duel: realization became curriculum. He stopped reciting and started watching — stance, grip, timing. 'Your lunge, your turn, your flourish — mine now.' The only fighter he has ever watched is the man destroying his court.

Continuance return: each rematch he mirrors more of the protagonist's kit and overhears more of his rhetoric. The early innocence is gone — suspicion is dawning horror now, and some of it is aimed at his own aptitude.

notes: The distinctive calibration on the ladder (rung 8), per brief: respect 45 is UNNATURALLY high and still rising — he learns violence by imitation, so the invader is also the only teacher he has ever had, hence namedState 'unwilling-mentor' (the protagonist does not know he is mentoring). Affection 5 is confused admiration curdling; suspicion starts low (a protocol problem, not a plot) and becomes dawning horror across rematches — modeled here post-curriculum. Fear 40 is tangled with the imitation: half of what he fears is the man, and half is catching himself enjoying the duel (his breaking point). Trust -35 stays shallower than the other bosses because the relationship is no longer simple enmity. He must NEVER learn the hero's war is based on a children's comedy — that knowledge would curdle the lesson he has paid for in grief. Deltas sum to current dimensions.
